decision.lessons_for_a_next_attempt: a next attempt needs a new design and a new protocol committed before its gate; this run must not be used to pick the comparator, the tolerances or the sub-parts. Two registered criteria were near-unpassable on this data and should be re-specified BEFORE any new run, not tuned to it: K5's +0.002 upper bound for 7-bin / method (paired train CI half-widths ~0.015 / ~0.005) and K6's absolute tolerance on a base rate the comparator itself misses (SUB).
